story.title: Changes at Google DeepMind: Demis Hassabis from CEO to Chair, Jeff Dean departs

draft:
Demis Hassabis is stepping down as CEO of Google DeepMind to become its chair. 
I've been following DeepMind's work and this change might signal a shift in focus. 
Key changes include Jeff Dean's departure and a renewed emphasis on AI momentum. 
What does this mean for the future of AI research?
#AI #GoogleDeepMind #TechLeadership
